name: intro
label: Intro
default: The assumptions that keep teams stuck, and the reality that changes the math.

default.myth: Agencies just sell you more tools you won't use.
default.reality: We start with outcomes and use the stack you already own — new tools only when they pay for themselves.

default.myth: We need more leads to grow.
default.reality: Most teams don't have a lead problem — they have a system problem. Connecting what you have unlocks pipeline you're already paying for.

default.myth: AI and automation are too complex for our team.
default.reality: We build the workflows and hand you a system your team actually runs — with humans in the loop where it matters.

default.myth: This will take a year to show results.
default.reality: We build in weeks, not quarters — typically with qualified pipeline lift inside 90 days and quick wins in the first few weeks.
